Container.Name: rsync-dashboard
Container.Overview: Read-only dashboard for your unRAID rsync backup jobs. Reads the log files your existing rsync scripts already write and shows per-job status, duration, data transferred, and files deleted. Never touches the scripts themselves and can't trigger backups.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to reach the dashboard from a browser

Config.Name: Logs Folder
Config.Description: The folder your rsync scripts already write their logs to (LOG_DIR in your scripts). Mounted read-only -- the dashboard cannot modify or delete anything here.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone so log timestamps display correctly

Config.Name: History Limit
Config.Description: How many past runs to keep per job

Config.Name: Cache Seconds
Config.Description: How long results are cached before logs are re-read

Config.Name: State Folder
Config.Description: Where alert settings (from the gear icon in the dashboard) and already-sent-alert memory are stored. Keep this mapped or your settings vanish on the next container update.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. 99 = unRAID's nobody, so the State Folder is writable. Change only if your appdata is owned by another user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. 100 = unRAID's users group.

Config.Name: Settings Password
Config.Description: Required to change alert settings or send test messages from the dashboard (viewing stays open, no login). Use 12+ random ASCII characters. Without it the settings panel is read-only.

Config.Name: Trusted Hosts
Config.Description: Optional, recommended: the IP or hostname(s) you open the dashboard with, comma-separated (e.g. 192.168.1.10,tower.local). Requests with any other Host header are rejected, which blocks DNS-rebinding attacks from web pages. Leave empty to accept any host.

Config.Name: Frame Ancestors
Config.Description: Only needed if you embed the dashboard in another dashboard (Organizr, Homepage, ...): the origin allowed to frame it, e.g. https://organizr.home.lan. Default: only the dashboard itself.
